summary: This bill amends federal law to prohibit the imprisonment or detention of any individual based solely on their actual or perceived protected characteristics, such as race, religion, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends federal law to prohibit detention based solely on protected characteristics, aiming to prevent unlawful detention and ensure due process. This directly relates to the fairness and legality of detention practices, pushing towards a system that protects individuals from arbitrary imprisonment based on identity.
